propositions: Findings carry an impact-only severity label that does not order the same as the authoritative priority (validity × impact), creating a foot-gun where a critical-severity finding ranks below a major-severity one.

The severity label is read via _KERNEL_TO_COMMON_SEVERITY, surfacing the same finding as different severities (INFO then MEDIUM) across identical runs when only impact drifted, appearing as a false severity change.
Review-kernel must stop stamping severity onto emitted findings and all its consumers (aggregation, dedup, Gerrit review-bot, CLI renderers, workflow gates) must migrate to priority/decision instead.

Non-review-kernel severity (completion-verification cluster, spec_scan.py) remains untouched since those modules never compute priority/validity/impact and are unaffected by the impact-only label bug.
